title: Kyoto trip — day plan
body: Day 1: Fushimi Inari at 7am before the crowds, then Nishiki market for lunch. Day 2: Arashiyama bamboo grove, rent bikes, tofu lunch at the temple. Day 3: day trip to Nara — deer park, Todai-ji. Book the ryokan in Gion by March 1st. JR pass covers the Haruka from Kansai airport.

title: Book quotes worth keeping
body: "The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago. The second best time is now." — proverb. "We are what we repeatedly do." — Will Durant summarising Aristotle. Re-read Thinking in Systems, chapter 5, on leverage points.

title: Gift ideas
body: Mom: pressed flower frame, the cardamom tea from the market, concert tickets (she loves jazz). Dad: a good chef's knife, the Ken Burns national parks box set. Leo: Lego Saturn V, glow-in-the-dark star map for his ceiling.

title: App idea: voice memos that file themselves
body: Record a thought while walking; it gets transcribed, tagged and linked to related notes automatically. Must work offline. Search should land on the exact moment in the memo, not just the file. Could share one embedding model for audio, images and text.

title: Running plan — 10k in 8 weeks
body: Mon rest. Tue intervals 6x400m. Wed easy 5k. Thu tempo 20 min. Sat long run, +1 km each week from 6 km. Sun yoga. Race day: Sunday 7 December, Riverside 10k, bib pickup Saturday.

title: Bug: worker can't reach Redis
body: orbit.worker crashes at startup with ConnectionRefusedError [Errno 111] against 10.0.4.12:6379. Redis container restarted after the kernel update and came back on a new IP. Fix: use the service name redis:6379 instead of a hard-coded IP, add retry with backoff. Screenshot saved.

title: Sourdough schedule
body: Feed starter 9pm. Mix dough 8am: 500 g flour, 375 g water, 100 g starter, 10 g salt. Stretch and fold every 30 min for 2 hours. Bulk until 50% risen, shape, cold retard overnight. Bake 250°C lid on 20 min, 230°C lid off 25 min.

title: Podcast episode ideas
body: 1) Why we went to the moon — Kennedy's Rice University speech, 1962. 2) The sound of a city at night. 3) Interview: a luthier who builds cellos. 4) What birdsong at dawn tells you about a forest.

title: Apartment hunt checklist
body: Natural light in the living room, gas stove, bike storage, under 25 min to the office, quiet bedroom away from the street. Ask about the heating bill in winter and whether the lease allows a cat.

title: Wedding toast draft
body: I've known Maya since we were nine and she talked me into building a raft that sank in eleven seconds. Daniel, she will talk you into many rafts. Some of them will float. To Maya and Daniel!

title: Things to photograph this autumn
body: Golden hour at the bridge, fog over the bay, the maple on Elm Street when it turns red, steam from the coffee cart on a cold morning, mountain roads with larches.
